name: MJML Knowledge Base
description: Technical reference for MJML v4 components and attributes.
global_rules: Layout Hierarchy: mjml -> mj-body -> mj-section -> mj-column -> components.
Content tags (mj-text, mj-image, mj-button, etc.) MUST be inside an <mj-column>.
Sections cannot be nested. Use <mj-wrapper> if you need to wrap multiple sections.
Tags are case-sensitive and must be lowercase.

mj-section.description: A horizontal block. Must contain mj-column or mj-group.

mj-column.description: A vertical container inside a section. Usually width is percentage or pixels summing to section width.

mj-text.description: The only way to render text content.

mj-style.description: Used in <mj-head> for CSS. Use inline="inline" for maximum compatibility.
mj-style.special_use: Essential for gradients and hover effects.

best_practices: Always use fallback fonts like 'Arial, sans-serif'.
Gradients should be implemented via <mj-style inline="inline"> classes.
Use padding instead of margins for spacing.
Keep total email width around 600px for optimal consistency.
